website_summary.name: Fantasy City Manager
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and strategic interface with a seashell background and crimson-accented content blocks, designed for players to select races and manage resources in a text-based strategy game.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist yet engaging design with a seashell background that provides a soft contrast to the vibrant crimson used for content blocks. The main page prominently displays the title "SELECT YOUR RACE" in bold, crimson font. Below the title, there are four rectangular content blocks, each representing a different race—Human, Dragonborn, Elf, and Dwarf—with their respective attributes and bonuses clearly listed. The text within these blocks is well-organized, with headings in a serif font ("Cinzel") and body text in a sans-serif font ("Raleway"). The layout is responsive, switching between a single-column view on smaller screens and a two-column grid on larger screens.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to choose a race by clicking on one of the four content blocks. Each race offers unique bonuses in attack, defense, and resource production. Beyond race selection, the game includes multiple pages such as ranking, store, train, workers, upgrades, bank, messages, and reports, enabling players to manage resources, upgrade facilities, train units, and engage in battles. Users can navigate through these pages via a menu or links, though the screenshot only shows the race selection page.

functionality_testing.expected_results: The Dragonborn race should be selected, and the UI should confirm this selection. 7. Next Steps : Click on the Dragonborn card to select the race.

functionality_testing.name: Dwarf Race Card Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that hovering over the Dwarf card displays accurate attributes.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The Dwarf race card is visible on the screen.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The Dwarf race card should display the correct attributes without any discrepancies. 7. Next Steps : Hover over the Dwarf race card to ensure all attributes are visible and accurate.
procedure: Verify that the displayed attributes match the expected values : Attack Bonus: -10%, Defense Bonus: 30%, Resource Bonus: 20% bonus to iron production.
